coreMemory.english: n. the achievement of a desired result
coreMemory.structure: achieve success /ətʃiv səkˈses/（取得成功）；great success /ɡreɪt səkˈses/（巨大成功）；key to success /ki tu səkˈses/（成功的关键）；chance of success /tʃæns ʌv səkˈses/（成功机会）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use success with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of success in context；❌ translate success word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “achieve success”

commonErrors.wrong: use success with the same article in every context

commonErrors.right: check the countability of success in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv səkˈses ɪn kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。
